'''Paul Laudenbach''' (also published as '''Paul Laudenbahch''') is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 3rd at [[January 2001 Fitchburg tournament]] on 20 January 2001 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|HB flip]], according to Hayes Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1650">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-21-fitchburg-ma-1-20-01d1650/ fitchburg-ma-1-20-01], DeckTech (Hayes "Hayes" Hunter, 21 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-21-fitchburg-ma-1-20-01d1650/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Paul Laudenbach also played at [[June 2000 Milford tournament]] on 10 June 2000 with [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|Trooper This Deal]], according to Eric Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d873">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-11-milford-mass-why-3a-will-save-me2k-6-10d873/ milford-mass-why-3a-will-save-me2k-6-10], DeckTech (Eric "bounty22" Hunter, 11 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-11-milford-mass-why-3a-will-save-me2k-6-10d873/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
